description: This file defines the CatalogItem class used in a Blazor project, representing a product item with properties such as Id, CatalogType, CatalogBrand, Name, Description, Price, and image data handling methods.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Represents a catalog item with properties for identification, categorization, description, pricing, and image data.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates if the provided image file name and base64 data represent a valid image within size constraints.

methods.name: DataToBase64
methods.description: Converts an uploaded file into a Base64-encoded string asynchronously.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension is among allowed image formats.
